trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Murex Specialist (Market Risk)
Company: FirstRand
Purpose of the role: The Murex Specialist is responsible for understanding the full lifecycle of a trade from Pricing to Settlement and the impact on Market Risk, Finance, Credit Risk and Collateral. Continuous development of Murex Platform is done by enhancing current functionality and building out for new business requirements. The role performs across the Markets, Banking and Treasury Business Units.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Analyse existing processes and facilitate improvements with stakeholders.
  - Work with traders and other stakeholders to gather and document requirements
  - Conduct impact analysis, understand trader's pain points and propose solutions
  - Coordinate and participate in the test effort to ensure that the delivered solution meets agreed business requirements and functional/process specifications.
  - Configure/Develop Solutions in the Murex Platform to meet business needs
  - Participate in analytical queries such as Risk, PnL and Pricing as well as technical queries linked to Workflows, Integrations and Reporting
  - Compile training material and provide end-user training to stakeholders where relevant.
  - Collaborate with internal technical team/users in the resolution of critical production incidents
  - Collaborate with Murex Vendor on suitable short- and long-term solutions for incidents and new requirements
  - Suggest changes in executing work processes to better drive value and benefits for the business.
  - Build and maintain professional working relationships with all stakeholders, displaying excellent abilities to initiate dialogue, listen, advise, influence and negotiate to achieve win-win outcomes.
  - Initiate meetings with key stakeholders to track progress, manage expectations and ensure stakeholders’ requirements are delivered
  - Build relationships despite arising conflicting views and seeks mutual gains when addressing conflicts
  - Anticipates consequences and adapts problem solving based on continuous feedback
  - Plan and manage own workflow, anticipating obstacles, juggling priorities and following through on objectives within agreed time-frames and according to quality standards
  - Stay relevant and up to date with legislations and new development
  - Take ownership of personal career development, leveraging formal and informal opportunities
  - Act in an ethical, transparent and morally defensible manner
  - Adapt communication styles to meet the needs of different audiences
  - Continually share, debate and communicate learning's, also flag and debate issues constructively to ensure the best outcome for business stakeholders and ultimately the bank
  - Contribute to a friendly, co-operative climate in working with others to achieve collective goals
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or related discipline is required
  - Strong functional knowledge of the Capital Markets Products and Business environment
  - Trade life cycle and financial markets asset classes like Derivatives, Interest Rate, Money Market, Fixed Income
  - Agile Scrum project execution process
  - Murex system modules - Front Office Configuration / Modules, Sensitivity, Risk issues, P&L Analysis, Pre-Trade Rule and Pricing Template setup
  - At least 3 years of experience in implementing and supporting Financial Markets systems and their interfaces between systems
  - Experience in Murex and/or MX TEST
Nice-to-have:
  - ACI Dealing Certificate advantageous
Location: Johannesburg
Team notes: Performs across the Markets, Banking and Treasury Business Units.
Closing date: 2026-11-12
Employment equity statement: All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group’s Employment Equity plan.
Accessibility statement: The Bank supports the recruitment and advancement of individuals with disabilities. In order for us to fulfill this purpose, candidates can disclose their disability information on a voluntary basis. The Bank will keep this information confidential unless we are required by law to disclose this information to other parties.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

Murex Specialist (Market Risk)

FirstRand

Johannesburg

About the role
You will work across the full trade lifecycle, from pricing through to settlement, and understand its impact on Market Risk, Finance, Credit Risk and Collateral. You will keep developing the Murex platform by enhancing current functionality and building for new business requirements. The role operates across the Markets, Banking and Treasury Business Units.

Your team
You will perform across the Markets, Banking and Treasury Business Units.

What you'll do
• Analyse existing processes and facilitate improvements with stakeholders.
• Gather and document requirements with traders and other stakeholders.
• Conduct impact analysis, understand traders' pain points and propose solutions.
• Configure and develop solutions in the Murex platform to meet business needs.
• Coordinate and take part in testing, so the delivered solution meets agreed business requirements and functional or process specifications.
• Work on analytical queries such as risk, PnL and pricing, and technical queries linked to workflows, integrations and reporting.
• Compile training material and train end users where relevant.
• Work with internal technical teams and users to resolve critical production incidents.
• Work with the Murex vendor on short- and long-term solutions for incidents and new requirements.
• Initiate meetings with key stakeholders to track progress, manage expectations and confirm requirements are delivered.
• Suggest changes to work processes that drive more value for the business.
• Plan and manage your own workflow, anticipating obstacles and meeting agreed timeframes and quality standards.

What you need
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or a related discipline.
• At least 3 years of experience implementing and supporting financial markets systems and the interfaces between them.
• Experience in Murex and/or MX TEST.
• Knowledge of Murex system modules: Front Office configuration and modules, sensitivity, risk issues, P&L analysis, pre-trade rule and pricing template setup.
• Strong functional knowledge of capital markets products and the business environment, including the trade lifecycle and asset classes such as derivatives, interest rate, money market and fixed income.
• Working knowledge of the Agile Scrum project execution process.

Nice to have
• ACI Dealing Certificate.

Closing date: 2026-11-12

The Bank supports the recruitment and advancement of individuals with disabilities. In order for us to fulfill this purpose, candidates can disclose their disability information on a voluntary basis. The Bank will keep this information confidential unless we are required by law to disclose this information to other parties.

All appointments will be made in line with FirstRand Group's Employment Equity plan.

You will keep up to date with legislation and new developments, adapt your communication to different audiences, and share and debate learnings constructively with business stakeholders.
